summary: Beacon Financial Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for an offering of fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036, a routine debt issuance under Rule 424(b)(5). The notes will be unsecured, subordinated, and not listed on any exchange, with optional redemption beginning in 2031 subject to Federal Reserve approval. Terms such as aggregate principal amount, interest rate, and offering price are blank in the preliminary supplement. This is an ordinary capital raise, not a special situation. Proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes, with no acquisition, tender, or strategic event. Watch for final pricing in the priced prospectus, but no risk-arb angle exists.
